name: Saint Teresa of Ávila
history: A Carmelite nun who, after years of lukewarm prayer, was converted before an image of the wounded Christ. She reformed her order, founding seventeen convents of the Discalced Carmelites, and wrote The Way of Perfection and The Interior Castle. In 1970 she became the first woman named a Doctor of the Church.
prayer: Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you. All things are passing; God never changes. Patience obtains all things. Whoever has God lacks nothing. God alone suffices.
meditation: Prayer, Teresa said, is nothing else than an intimate sharing between friends. Speak to Christ today as a friend.
